finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms it.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, so any order with both a non-zero discount and a non-zero tax rate came out wrong. Fixed it to apply tax after the discount (`applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`) — suite is green, verify.js passes.
